title: Midweek Corridor Regression Signal Digest
content:
Midweek Corridor — Regression Signal Digest

Purpose:
- Lightweight, action-first midweek snapshot for onboarding/eval regressions and promptset health. Not a complete postmortem — quick triage and owners for the next 72h.

High-level summary (last 7 days):
- Aggregate onboarding pass-rate dropped to 90.6% (was 94.1 two weeks ago).
- Spike in formatting/serialization failures for structured-output promptsets (noted around 06/20).
- Rise in short-form hallucination cases in Knowledge-QA promptset group (top failure cohort).
- A/B trial with quantized 8-bit variant showed minor speed gains but correlated to 1.8% higher instruction-following deviations on the prompt subsets used for onboarding.

Top failure buckets (priority order):
1) Structured-output parse errors (JSON/XML) — 34% of alerts. Symptoms: missing fields, trailing text after JSON block.
   - Likely causes: tokenizer split on special tokens in our post-prompts; recent prompt truncation optimization on serving-runtime.
2) Fact hallucination in short QA prompts — 27% of alerts. Examples show confident-but-wrong facts for niche product specs.
   - Likely causes: model switch to v2b (experiment) + prompt paraphrasing drift in new promptset v3.
3) Instruction-following drop (formatting/verbosity) — 18% of alerts.
   - Symptoms: model ignoring required bullets or returning prose when list was requested.
4) Latency tail for long-context onboarding tests — 12% of alerts.
5) Other: tokenization edge cases and rate-limiter 429s during burst tests — 9%.

Representative examples (redacted):
- Promptset: onboarding/structured-order-v2 -> Output truncated JSON (missing order.total): 
  \"{\"order\": {\"items\": [{\"id\": \"X1\"}] }\"
- Promptset: onboarding/knowledge-qa -> Model response: \"The product launched in 2018\" (actual: 2020).
- Promptset: onboarding/instructions -> \"Sure, here is a paragraph describing steps\" (expected: numbered list of 3 bullets).

Telemetry & signal notes:
- Alerting sources: eval-runner nightly sampler, customer-sim harness, and manual onboarding smoke tests.
- Correlated change windows: 06/19 runtime push (batching heuristics) and 06/20 model pin to v2b-q8 (experimental).
- Signal confidence: medium. Noise from small prompt variations; need to re-run with controlled prompt copies.

Immediate mitigations (next 72h):
- Rollback candidate: revert model pin for onboarding/knowledge-qa to v2a on dedicated test lane. Owner: Miguel S. Target: 2026-06-24 EOD. (JIRA:INF-1427)
- Hotfix prompt tweak: append explicit JSON boundary token (\"---JSON-END---\") to structured-output system prompts for onboarding/structured-order-v2. Owner: Priya N. Target: 2026-06-23 morning.
- Canary rule: route 20% of onboarding traffic to legacy decoders for structured-output promptsets until we validate fix. Owner: Evan L. Target: 2026-06-24.

Longer-term action items (backlog / sprint planning):
- Create regression harness subset that reproduces the structured-output truncation deterministically. Owner: eng-test infra. Due: sprint-27 planning.
- Investigate quantization/regression interaction (v2b-q8). Run controlled evals comparing v2a/v2b across prompt clusters. Owner: Applied ML. Linked EVAL: EVAL-708.
- Expand promptset coverage for niche product spec QA (add 120 targeted examples). Owner: SE promptops. Due: 2026-07-05.
- Add a pre-parse validator that flags malformed JSON outputs and triggers a fallback renderer. Owner: serving-runtime.

Triage notes / decisions taken today:
- Prioritized structured-output parse errors because they directly block downstream ingestion pipelines.
- Decided to hold off on global rollback until we confirm spike isn't solely from new prompt paraphrases in test corpus.
- Agreed to treat v2b-q8 as experimental on onboarding lanes until quantization regression suite passes.

Quick checklist for owners (copy/paste into PRs and tickets):
- Reproduce failure locally with exact prompt snapshot used in the nightly sample.
- Include raw model output + tokenization boundaries in ticket (searchable tag: onboarding-raw).
- Run the small A/B bench comparing v2a / v2b-q8 over the 4 affected prompt clusters.
- If parse-fail rate > 7% during canary, enact immediate rollback routing.

Heatmap snapshot (summary numbers):
- Structured-output parse fail rate: 3.4% -> current. (alert threshold 2.0%)
- Knowledge-QA incorrect-fact rate: 2.8% (baseline 1.1%)
- Instruction-following deviation: 2.1% (baseline 1.5%)
- Median latency (onboarding samplers): 140ms -> tail p95 520ms.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Is the new batching heuristic truncating system message tokens prior to model? Need SRE trace.
- Did the v2b quantization introduce subtle tokenization shifts that affect special delimiter handling?
- Are customer-sim harness samples representative of production traffic cadence?

Files & links to check:
- JIRA:INF-1427 (rollback candidate)
- EVAL:708 (quantization regression suite config)
- PR-912 (serving-runtime batching change)
- Confluence onboarding playbook (promptset canonical copy)

Next sync (30-min): 2026-06-24 09:30 PT — quick owners stand to lock rollback/canary steps.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this digest tight; avoid overload. Pull in more examples only if we can't reproduce.
- Might be useful to run tokenizer-visualizer across failing examples to spot boundary issues.

-----
